name: pinterest-references
description: Pinterest MCP server by terryso, wrapped by FrameCore Works: search public Pinterest pins by keyword for moodboards and style, typography and composition references, through the pinned pinterest-mcp-server 1.2.0. References only: pins are not licensed assets. Needs Google Chrome and Node.js with npx; no account or API key.

interface.longDescription: Keyword search of public Pinterest pins for moodboards and style, typography and composition references, with the pinned pinterest-mcp-server 1.2.0 by terryso (MIT). Each saved image keeps its pin link and author. References only: Pinterest images belong to their authors and are never used in finished work. Needs Google Chrome in its standard place and Node.js with npx; no account or API key.
